summary: Accepted with two non-blocking findings: demo.html is not smoke-tested by the inline fixture, and comments claiming fresh sessions do not match cumulative messages because Reset does not reinitialize/remount.
review_report: XR-harness review outcome: ACCEPT with two non-blocking findings. Evidence: interaction/check.mjs uses Playwright Chromium, serves .wasm as application/wasm, loads mountGobi/WASM, compares state/tree/messages plus rendered html/outerHTML and disabled paths, and drives child-index paths 1/2; this matches current DOM adapter. Findings: (1) its browser page is an inline parity fixture, so interaction/demo.html itself is not smoke-tested despite root's request to test the mounted demo if feasible; (2) comments say each script starts in a fresh session, but code only clicks Reset and does not call runtime init, so messages remains cumulative across scenario boundaries. Reviewer sent the same findings to harness; recommend add demo smoke and either reinitialize/remount or change the fresh-session claim.
findings: interaction/demo.html is not smoke-tested; browser check covers only the inline parity fixture.
Scenario comments claim fresh sessions, but Reset leaves the cumulative message log intact; reinitialize/remount or revise the claim.
